summary: Fixed Test Detail persistence path by capturing manual-test generation errors in all_done events, persisting manualTests/manualTestsError onto run.json, and replacing the generic missing-details response with actionable fallback text (including error reason when available). Added regression coverage for persistence and gTD fallback behavior; verified with pnpm vitest run src/goal/manual-tests.test.ts and focused run-store/goal-commands test suites.
